title: When the Radiators Wakes
author: Zephyrine Thornbury
blurb: Rosalind Blackwood, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
